rows.text: [Trailblazer], Fulwish won't let up her media offensive. Watch your backs out there.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I'll remain aboard the Express and manage things from here. I'll provide support if needed.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I'll leave things on the Express to you. It's in good hands.
You be careful too, Mr. Yang.
Don't you worry about me. I've still got plenty of fight left in me yet.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I heard it, too...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Precisely. Aha has raised the stakes. The final winner will inherit the authority of Elation itself.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The most logical explanation is that Aha wants to steer this game toward utter... insanity. But then, who can possibly fathom the mind of an Aeon?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Not every Phantasmoon Games's ending has been recorded. Many were lost to time, most likely a consequence of the winners exercising their newfound divine authority.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Exactly, it's just too weird! Can you really just give up being an Aeon? What if this is just a big prank by those Masked Fools?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Basically, unless what the Phantasmoon said is some cruel joke or a play on words... once the Games are over, a new god will be born, one of unknown identity, unknown morality, and unknown purpose.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You mean "A pessimist sees a half-empty glass, but an optimist sees a half-full one"?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, don't you worry, [Trailblazer]! I'm here. I'll protect you!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You wished that if you won the Phantasmoon Games, "Aha would become the new leader of the Anti-Destruction Alliance"...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: No way... it's Baseball Raccoon, March Bunny, and Himekat, in the flesh! What are they doing here?
rows.speaker: Excited Fan of "The Fluffy"

rows.text: You smash anyone who stands in your way with that bat!
rows.speaker: Hopeful Passerby

rows.text: You're right. The fact that the Phantasmoon openly made a promise is anything but ordinary.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: To prevent the divine authority from falling into the wrong hands, the Supplicants may go to any lengths now with their tactics and actions.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yeah, that's right. We came here to win. A bigger prize doesn't change that.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Correct. It would be wise to keep a low profile and stay out of the public eye.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: It isn't required, but I advise you to limit your appearances in public spaces.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The Media and Public Relations Department has been monitoring public sentiment. At present, speculation and criticism regarding the Astral Express are surging.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I can. But you overestimate what "control" really means. In the arena of public opinion, those who look strong are often the ones at a disadvantage. And besides—
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Regrettably, I cannot agree to this. Clarifying the facts amid a frenzy of public sentiment is like trying to quell boiling water by stirring it, it only fuels the flames.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: That much is certain. Still, given the current volatility of public sentiment, please exercise caution and self-control.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: We cannot allow her to deceive and poison innocent people in the name of "happiness."
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Whatever her excuse is, killing others as if it's just a game is beyond forgiveness.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Cinderborne... and his friends only wished to become heroes, yet Fulwish toyed with them, trampled their dreams, and cast them aside as expendable pieces.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Agreed. Given the likelihood of Fulwish acting unpredictably, we should confront her with everything we have.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, the monster who turned living flesh into his artwork would, in the heat of combat, slip into bouts of frenzied elation and delirium.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: He claimed that in his hallucinations, the golden tree's branches coiled around him, drowning him in frenzy and pleasure. He wanted its blossoms to bloom before all, and to bring about that "miracle," he was willing to slaughter without restraint.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I cannot say whether the vision this madman claimed to see corresponds to something real. But the possibility cannot be ruled out.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I cannot say whether the vision this madman claimed to see corresponds to something real. But the possibility cannot be ruled out.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: If you're set, let's get moving.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Mm-hmm. Fulwish isn't an opponent to be taken lightly, we'll need to be thoroughly prepared. See you at the academy.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You're back.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Himeko messaged me. She filled me in on the Star Rail FEST and the Phantasmoon's declaration. Things really are changing fast.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Our allies may start to have second thoughts...
I believe our objectives remain the same.
Still, the mere fact that the Phantasmoon made a declaration is anything but ordinary...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: After all, in most people's minds, they alone are the ones best suited to wield power. Right or wrong has little to do with it. Such is the nature of human will.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yeah, and that may be exactly what the Phantasmoon wishes to see: a spectacular head-on battle of ambitions.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Madam Pearl has sent a communication request to the Astral Express. Accept transmission?
rows.speaker: Communication Hint

rows.text: It hasn't been long since we parted, and here I am disturbing you once more. My sincerest apologies.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Please, there's no need to apologize. Given the urgency of this transmission, Madam Pearl, I assume you wish to discuss the Phantasmoon's recent declaration?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Nothing manipulates people's emotions quite like that moon in the sky. A permanent handover of divine authority... it is unprecedented.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I can't help but wonder whether some malicious presence lurks behind the Phantasmoon. Still... who else but the Elation THEMSELF could wield such control over it?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: In any case, the Phantasmoon's speech has made the public realize that the power to "create a god" is in their hands. Their emotions... and perhaps even their Wishpower... are swelling to historic levels. The Department of Aberration Defense even detected a surge of agitation and unrest among the imagenae.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: When normal people believe power rests in their hands, their decisions tend to grow more radical and reckless. Please be careful, and make sure to protect yourselves.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Protect ourselves?
We need protection?
I've seen it online myself. Following the fight with the Daybreak Warriors, there's been no shortage of hostile commentary aimed at [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: A commentary program on TV has been claiming the Express's adventures are nothing but stories fabricated by the IPC.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Many believe the Astral Express is oppressing the local heroes, and some are even speculating that [Trailblazer] is the new Herald of Death.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: What the—!? What's wrong with these people!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: These narratives are undoubtedly being amplified by media platforms steered by Fulwish.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I've received a report from the Security Bureau. They tell me that many fans of the Daybreak Squadron have been stirred up and are threatening retaliation against the Express...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I'll reinforce security in case agitators attempt to storm the station.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You... can control public opinion, can't you?
...And besides, you'll be distancing yourself from us for a while, isn't that right?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That is accurate. We intend to scale back our public association for the time being. If it's confirmed that the Express is "colluding with the IPC," its public image would only deteriorate further.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Why don't we disclose what really happened in that fight?
"The Happiness Surgery causes recipients to undergo an Abundance Transformation." Disclosing such sensational information would probably be taken as a hoax, or trigger public panic.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I will instruct the Department of Aberration Defense to verify the true mechanism behind the Happiness Surgery as soon as possible and assess its potential impact.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I strongly advise you to exercise restraint in front of the media. Even the smallest statement can be selectively edited and misrepresented.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This is all Fulwish's doing!

I sincerely hope that the Phantasmoon's declaration will not disrupt the goodwill between us. A greater danger still stands before us: After listening to the declaration, who knows what extremes Fulwish might be driven to?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Affairs demand my attention, so I must excuse myself. Should there be further developments, I will keep you apprised.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The new Herald of Death is real! They say he came back to life and was responsible for what happened in Dovebrook!
rows.speaker: Apprehensive Student

rows.text: He's not coming here to kill again, i—is he? Maybe we should ask for leave and stay home until this blows over?
rows.speaker: Apprehensive Student

rows.text: What are you, scared? If he really comes, I'm livestreaming the whole thing and getting all the clout for it. Who needs leave after that? I'll just quit school altogether!
rows.speaker: Ecstatic Student

rows.text: What do you know about the Herald of Death?
I heard he murdered hundreds of students here, fifteen years ago!
rows.speaker: Ecstatic Student

rows.text: H—Hundreds? Really? I only heard that the crime scene still exists somewhere on campus.
rows.speaker: Apprehensive Student

rows.text: I—I don't feel too good about this. We should get out of here!
rows.speaker: Apprehensive Student

rows.text: If we help the Express gang, there's a chance we might get featured in The Fluffy!
rows.speaker: Ecstatic Student

rows.text: You're seriously obsessed with becoming famous!
rows.speaker: Apprehensive Student

rows.text: A computer that's probably older than you, living out its golden years on this desk.
Search "Fulwish."
Search "Herald of Death Incident."
Search "Himeko."
Let's just stop there for now.
"Renowned entrepreneur Fulwish visits school recently" "Fulwish warmly shakes hands with students" "What did they take away from the speech? Here's what these three students had to say"...
There are so many press releases here...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Scroll forward a bit.
Scroll to the earliest record.
"Renowned entrepreneur Fulwish donates scholarship," "School makes first appearance in Fulwish TV's annual university rankings," "Fulwish TV covers our school's anniversary celebration once again"...
Scroll to the earliest record.
The school's "Annual Distinguished Students Register" from 1982 to 1984?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The school's "Annual Distinguished Students Register" from 1982 to 1984?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: For three consecutive years... first place was always Fulwish.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "No results found for your search"... The search page slaps the black text on a white background right in your face.
The IPC has severed all channels of intel with its iron grip. Hardly a surprise.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Formal caution regarding a student's non-compliant hairstyle," "Disciplinary action concerning a student's involvement in three food poisoning cases," "Disciplinary notice for a student's involvement in a physical altercation"...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Simply magnificent! You read with bated breath, and it takes a good long while before you snap out of it... Right, this isn't exactly the task at hand.
At the very bottom of all the entries regarding Himeko lies a faculty appointment notice from fifteen years ago.

"That new red-haired assistant is the dean's daughter. Her constitution is weak, so she can't handle heavy labor. Remember: don't assign her anything outside of clerical work." So read the note in the file.
Open up! Detective March 7th is on the case, so spill the beans! How much do you know about what happened fifteen years ago?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You've got the wrong guy, I swear! I'm just an innocent, cursed imagenae... I can't even move from this spot. I don't know anything, waaah.
rows.speaker: Froggy Whiteboard

rows.text: Ribbet, ribbet, the dean ordered me to dig up whatever materials I could find for you all to read!
rows.speaker: Froggy Whiteboard

rows.text: The label of this cabinet reads "Alumni Yearbook."
In which year did Fulwish graduate? You seem to remember you obtained this information somewhere...
Recall deeper...
I remember it all along!
Sometimes, a little deduction is sufficient to make up for missing memories.
It is currently Year 1999 of the Planarcadian calendar. The Herald of Death incident took place 15 years ago...
The year Fulwish graduated is...
Flip through the alumni yearbook for the class of 1982.
Flip through the alumni yearbook for the class of 1983.
Flip through the alumni yearbook for the class of 1984.
Your gaze sweeps across the youthful, smiling faces in the photo. It feels surreal to think that these people are now pushing middle age.
Regrettably, Fulwish was not among them.

The yearbook's got a pretty wild design. Everyone in the graduation photo's dressed like they raided a costume shop, and some genius even brought their illegal imagenated creations for the group shot. This school's culture sure is... quite liberal...
Regrettably, Fulwish was not among them.

The first page is a somber graduation photo. None of the students in the photo betrayed any hint of a smile. They stood sparsely, like the teeth in an aged person's mouth, separated by absences that could never be filled.
In the alumni yearbook for the class of 1984, you find the page belonging to Fulwish.
We should be able to find the archive room and Ms. Dollie around... the Imagenesis classroom, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is this...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Could Sparxie really have pulled the same trick again and left you a "gift" at the school?
Did they really have to put this here...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Wait a minute, this nostalgia isn't an aftereffect of the Sparxie Virus, r—right!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I think it's best we see my father first.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Should we go and find Mr. Ryusuke first?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's only appropriate that we obtain permission from the dean before proceeding with the investigation.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Stop, stop! Every time you and [Trailblazer] get together, the conversation somehow drifts completely off course...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: To be honest, it wasn't until the Herald of Death incident fifteen years ago that I first learned her name.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, I received a commission to paint a massive portrait for an Elixir Seeker chief on the planet of Goliath's Shepherd. They said he had an elixir that could cure countless diseases...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: You're always welcome. Other than the archive room, you could also try talking to Ms. Dollie. She's the longest-serving faculty member here and likely knows the most.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Do you really need all the details? The whole "serving as a model example" thing... I don't want to tarnish it completely.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Fulwish...? The poor child who survived the Herald of Death?
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: You tell Himeko about the clues you discovered in the alumni catalog...
I know the guys from the Strategic Investment Department have been nice to us, but... whenever something bad goes down in the cosmos, the first thing everyone thinks is, "The IPC did it, right?"
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You mean she created the "Happiness Surgery" after studying on that greenhouse world?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm more inclined to think that after witnessing the power of the Herald of Death, she resolved to uncover the truth behind it. That's why she went to another world to study after graduation... But is the knowledge she gained in just a few short years enough to create the Happiness Surgery?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Back then... I had taken a leave of absence from university due to health issues, so I was doing some idle work at my father's school to clear my mind.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Me too!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I am here to mourn that dusk from fifteen years ago.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: I thought Himeko was at school like the rest of us that day.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: I would advise everyone to think twice before making rash accusations.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: You're really going to the TV station to fight her?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sparxie.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Sunday!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ever since Sunday was dragged into the Phantasmoon Games by Yao Guang, he hasn't returned for days.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Her claim might just be a glorified way of saying... The Tavern sent her an invitation.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Correct.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: If every Fool has stepped into the Tavern before, then there must be traces hidden there left by Fulwish as a Fool, just like...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Ahh, well, after that so-called "dream campus experience," we've ended up back at Graphia Academy. It's almost like revisiting the place after graduation.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry, March. The Department of Aberration Defense conducted a "comprehensive disinfection" of the campus.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That's a relief. The last thing I need is to be mid-investigation and suddenly morph into some hopping, dancing mushroom rabbit...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Speaking of which, where should we begin our investigation into Fulwish?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Maybe we should start with the teachers who are familiar with the situation?
How about talking to the dean first?
Fifteen years have passed, but there should be a backup of the student files, work logs, or visitor records, and only he knows where they're stored.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Let's go then. To the dean's office.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Himeko! There you are at last!
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: The news said you got into a huge fight with those... what were they called... warriors at the floating isle exhibition, and then you disappeared! Let me see, you're not hurt anywhere, are you?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I sent you a dozen messages and you didn't reply to a single one! Do you have any idea how worried I was!?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: But seeing that you've come to tell me you're safe in person, I'll... let this slide!
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: If you're really so preoccupied, a message or a call would do, you know...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Ah, it's you two. I saw you on the news, as well. Valiantly fought! Hah, these mechatron Warriors don't know who they're messing with, to think they dared challenge my daughter's subordinates.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Now it feels like we're the underlings of Warlord Himeko or something...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: In any case, I'll leave Himeko in your hands. Please, try to keep her out of combat.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Don't worry, I'm a great bodyguard!
I'm fine, I'm good. Your daughter's no porcelain doll. We came here to—
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I know. I understand... You didn't come as my "daughter," rather, I am currently speaking to the navigator of the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: But tell me... has there been progress on the new Herald of Death case? I wasn't expecting the questioning to come in rounds.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: In rounds?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Department of Aberration Defense also sent someone here before you. They inquired about Fulwish...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: But regrettably, I truly don't know how to answer. On one hand, I wasn't here fifteen years ago; on the other, she is still considered one of our school's distinguished alumni.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I'm aware that you're involved in the investigation too, so I compiled the pertinent documents ahead of time. I hope they'll be of use to you.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Thank you, Mr. Ryusuke.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Go ahead. The files are inside the archive room, take whatever materials you need.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Oh right, about Fulwish...
As the dean, I should've met up with her more often and tried harder to soothe the wounds it left on her. But I... I just couldn't.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Why?
I knew it was a selfish thought, but I just couldn't help it. Back then, whenever I heard her name, I thought to myself—
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: If someone was able to survive the incident, then why couldn't it have been my daughter?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, you...
By the time I came back, everything had changed. There had been a terrible accident on campus, and my daughter...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Even though I knew my presence here wouldn't have changed anything, because of that incident, I made a promise to never leave this world again during the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: That's why I immediately flew here when I heard about the full Phantasmoon. But once again, I was too late, and the Supplicant called Sparxie had turned the campus upside down.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: It's alright, you can leave the crisis-solving to the Nameless.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You're right about that. Yet oddly, once Sparxie stirred up all that chaos, applications to the school soared to an all-time high. The times we live in are increasingly beyond my comprehension.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: We won't take up any more of your time, then.
Then we'll try the archive room. Let's go, you two.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Thank you, Dad.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Oh my goodness, I thought I recognized you in the distance. Himeko, it really is you!
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: Ms. Dollie! Please forgive me for not coming to see you sooner. I've been back for a while now, but this is the first chance I've had to come see you.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Don't worry about it. I'm simply happy that you cared enough to visit!
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: I must apologize about the mask you entrusted me. In the end...
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: Please, I can't thank you enough for safeguarding the mask all those years.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hehe, look at you, you haven't changed a bit. You and your friends look like you're in a hurry. Is there something you need to attend to?
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: We're here to ask about Fulwish.
The school organized a fundraiser for her back then. I still remember how she bowed again and again with tears in her eyes at everyone who helped.
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: Poor girl. Though she was lucky to have survived, her parents... didn't make it. There were rumors flying around the school saying she had something to do with the Herald of Death. Otherwise, why would she be so lucky? She's the only one who survived... What a bunch of scoundrels!
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: She had good grades and a good heart. After becoming famous, she often came back to visit the school, and sponsored a number of scholarship projects.
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: Speaking of which, do you know anything about what happened to her after she graduated from school?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I heard she went somewhere beyond the sky to further her studies after graduation. She had the chance to work for the Interastral Peace Corporation, but chose to return home and take over Seafeld TV instead, which was on the verge of bankruptcy.
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: Somewhere beyond the sky... Ms. Dollie, do you know where she went exactly?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I never heard. However, she pushed out many projects after taking over the TV station, and managed to expand their business to the whole of Planarcadia in just a few years. That is all I know.
rows.speaker: Dollie

rows.text: Thank you, Ms. Dollie, for your intel.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The atmosphere in this archive room is giving me the creeps. It's so gloomy, almost like we've stumbled into Fyxestroll Garden...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It was like this fifteen years ago as well, the archives tracked all academic results. Near the final exams, students dissatisfied with their abilities often poured their frustration into painting... unsettling things.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: There's a lot of data stored here. Aside from what my father organized for us, let's explore the other areas as well.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: If possible, keep an eye out for clues regarding Fulwish's life after graduation. She returned to her alma mater frequently, so there must be records of her visits.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Dabbling in technology related to the Abundance... where exactly did she acquire it? Perhaps her past holds a clue.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Fulwish.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Himeko, you recognized me at just a glance.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: What are you doing here?
Before making any major decisions, I always come here to sit in silence for a while.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Fulwish...
When I saw Belle lying in a pool of blood, when I was crushed under the collapsed wall and unable to breathe, the thought crossed my mind...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Poor Himeko. If you had met the Herald of Death, with that delicate frame of yours...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: But who would have guessed? You're alive, and living quite well.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: You became the Navigator of the Astral Express, roaming freely beyond the sky. Just like the three of us used to talk about in our chats, your dream came true.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Congratulations are in order.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Himeko, do you know? Fifteen years have passed, and my wounds have mostly healed.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Regrettably, there are some scars and emptiness that time can never heal.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Look around. Even here, even with these phantoms... their seats are still empty. Belle, Lyon, Zyanya, Meeya, and so many others...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Fifteen years have passed, and I've learned that time isn't a cure. It's a shroud, binding itself around me layer upon layer.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: So, I made a decision. I'm going to tear it open! I'm going to let everything bloody and unforgettable beneath it... see the light of day again!
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: See the light of day? You were a victim of the Herald of Death, only to become the second Herald of Death yourself? You intend to use a power you can't possibly comprehend to win the Phantasmoon Games...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: How are you any different from that monster back then? From the monster that took your parents' lives?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...I'm sorry. I shouldn't compare you to that devil. You still have a chance... Stop this now.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Stop? I'm sorry, I don't quite understand what you're saying.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Just as I thought. She won't admit it...
As a media professional, let me give you a piece of advice. From now on, when you're in front of a camera lens, watch your expressions and be cautious with your words and actions.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: At the very least, try not to look so flustered during this "public exchange."
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: We live in a world where we are constantly gazed upon and watched by others.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: This camera crew was originally prepared for my upcoming speech. But meeting you all here... it really adds a wonderful dramatic flair.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: To the audience watching from your screens...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: You know my name, and I know that right now, you are watching me.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, with the tacit approval of the IPC and the arcadia council, the Master of Elation's divine ritual degenerated into a barbaric, bloody game!
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: You and I, the residents of this arcadia, surrendered a lifetime of dignity, wealth, and time to them, all in exchange for a single full meal.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: We are surrounded by bizarre entertainment and stimulating gore. We soak all day in shallow, boring programs, achieving nothing...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: And now? Now we must live in fear of the unscrupulous atrocities of these Supplicants from beyond the sky, forcing smiles as we applaud and cheer for them!
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Is this the happiness the god promised us?
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: No! Absolutely not! The Master of Elation would never be deceived by miracles bought with pain and blood! What THEY desire to see are heartfelt smiles. And so, THEY granted me a revelation.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Everyone, on that evening fifteen years ago, what saved me was not luck. It was not the Supplicants, and it was certainly not the IPC.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Right here, as the Herald of Death approached step by step, the one who sent down a miracle was the Master of Elation!
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: THEY allowed me to escape with my life. And when I was trapped in a small room, consumed by loneliness, THEY sent me a Mask!
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: THEY revealed my mission to me. To bring happiness back to a Planarcadia that has lost its smile!
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: I, Fulwish, survivor of the Bloodstained Games, hereby formally announce that I will join the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: In this game, I shall win the Aeon of Elation's authority...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: And then, I will make smiles of happiness bloom on the faces of every single person in Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Himeko, don't frown. Smile.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: I will bring happiness to you, too, just as I will bring it to everyone.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: I won't manipulate the Phantasmoon Games like those high-and-mighty IPC executives, nor will I treat the rewards granted by the God of Elation as bargaining chips for profit.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: We are in Planarcadia, so we should decide the winner in a "Planarcadian" way.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: I'll give you a stage, if that's what you want...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: I invite you all to a "Televised Debate" at Fulwish TV in Seafeld City. The invitation extends to... all Supplicants.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: A "Planarcadian" way? That's just a way that benefits you... We're not going!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You can refuse, of course. But then, under the gaze of billions of viewers, you must accept your public image as "frauds deceiving the world" and "cowards with guilty consciences."
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Remember, this isn't just an invitation. It is your only chance to defeat me in front of everyone... since you believe you represent what is "right."
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: The stage is set. Come and perform this final act that will determine the future of the arcadia with me. Or simply leave. The choice is yours.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Darn it, are we just going to let Fulwish walk away?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We are right in the middle of the cameras she prepared. Remember to be cautious with your words and actions.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Let's leave here and return to the Express.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hello everyone, and welcome back to the Arcadian Morning Report. We're continuing our exclusive coverage—
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: Just moments ago, we received some shocking news! The head of our station, Lady Fulwish, has officially announced that she will be entering the Phantasmoon Games as a Supplicant!
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: At the same time, Lady Fulwish has announced a blockbuster special: "The End of the Century TV Debate"! She is inviting Supplicants to the Fulwish TV studio to discuss and debate the topic: "What kind of future will the Phantasmoon Games bring to this world?"
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: What a magnificent topic! At a time when Supplicants from beyond the sky are brazenly suppressing and insulting our local heroes, finally, a Supplicant has appeared who truly cares about and represents the citizens of Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: Too true. Ever since these Phantasmoon Games began, signs of things spiraling out of control have been popping up everywhere. First, the famous streamer Sparxie tried to spread a memetic virus. Then, the Nameless of the Astral Express clashed with the Daybreak Squadron, causing severe damage to Lookout Cloud, and the Skyline Express line...
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: With so many accidents happening, you really can't help but wonder... Are we seeing a repeat of the "Bloodstained Games" from fifteen years ago!?
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: You got that right! Speaking of the "Bloodstained Games" fifteen years ago, Ms. Fulwish herself is a survivor of that tragedy. She's come such a long way, never once letting her painful past keep her down... a true legend of resilience!
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: Now, Ms. Fulwish has joined the fray as a Supplicant! She must be here to stop the tragedy from repeating itself, and to reclaim the peaceful days this world deserves from the hands of Supplicants from beyond the sky.
rows.speaker: Snowie

rows.text: Will she be able to shoulder the wishes of all Planarcadia and set this game right again after it's spiraled out of control? Let's wait and see!
rows.speaker: Poofy

rows.text: I'm so sorry! I just couldn't finish tidying up the ribbons, and now I've dragged you into staying this late.
rows.speaker: Belle

rows.text: Don't worry about it, Belle. It was my turn on duty today anyway.
Himeko, is this...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes. In this imagenated classroom, the afterimages of the students from fifteen years still linger in their original places.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Tomorrow is the school anniversary. I wonder how lively it will be? They've invited parents here... Will your parents be coming?
rows.speaker: Belle

rows.text: ...Fulwish?
rows.speaker: Belle

rows.text: Ah, that's Fulwish from her youth.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yeah, Dad already took time off. By now, he's probably out on the streets with Mom picking out formal wear—
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: "If it's my daughter's performance, we have to dress to the nines..." That's just like him. He always loves making those kinds of jokes.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Haha, then you'd better put on a good show, huh?
rows.speaker: Belle

rows.text: There won't be a show anymore... Belle.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: ...Because unexpected guests have arrived.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Everyone from the Astral Express, and... Himeko, I didn't expect to meet you here.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Did you enjoy yourselves at Star Rail FEST? Did you grant those {RUBY_B#Daybreak Squadron}smiling kids{RUBY_E#} their wishes and bring joy to everyone?
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: So shameless!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Reporting news about your own station director on your own TV station, and you still have the gall to pretend you've "received some shocking news"... Don't you guys talk to each other internally!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I see... Fulwish actively issued a challenge.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I ran a search. Seafeld City is a port town neighboring Duomension City. Fulwish TV's predecessor, Seafeld TV, is located there.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Looking at it this way, the televised debate is obviously nothing more than a diversion. What Fulwish wants most is for us to walk right into the trap she's prepared.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: So, [Trailblazer], what do you think?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I accept her challenge.
I'll go. But not to debate. I'm going to tear off her Mask of "Happiness" in front of the entire audience.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: But before we act, I need more help.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Help? We can all help you. Wait, do you mean...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: However, I haven't heard of him making any public appearances either. Asking him to cooperate as a wildcard right now is a good idea.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But what's the deal with finding Sparxie?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Whether Sparxie counts as "our ally" is a massive question mark, but right now there is indeed something we need her help with.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Fulwish said that when loneliness trapped her in that small room, the Master of Elation sent her a Mask.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Aha? For real?
But that phrasing reveals that she is likely a Masked Fool.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So, she's a Masked Fool?
How we tracked down the clues about SparxiCon.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Sparxie... will she stand on our side?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, this is certainly a condition she wouldn't be able to turn down.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is that their fate hanging over their heads?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Precisely. Come on, let's take a closer look.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: So, this so-called ruling... Does it involve summoning a bolt of lightning from the sky to just zap Fulwish dead out of nowhere?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: It's nothing so violent. For my judgment, I must first retrieve the sacred instrument...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Only by using it to measure the Supplicant's crimes can we sever her power. It's like... a gardener pruning overgrown branches.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: That's a cute puppy. Looks like it's taken a liking to you.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I'll just borrow this cutie's head for a sec.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Come on, quit blocking the way.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Ugh, I need to figure out a way to shake this little cutie off.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Relax, little pup.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Bid farewell to painful memories and embrace the eternal now! Let the smile of happiness become your only truth!
rows.speaker: Smiles Society Publicist

rows.text: Follow Master Fulwish's path, embrace rebirth, and you and I can both become the happiest people in this arcadia!
rows.speaker: Smiles Society Publicist

rows.text: A Weal slip. This one's a lucky weal, too.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Isn't that a good thing?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: This Fulwish really is something else.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: And this... is also a weal.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: We're almost there.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Let's go.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: What do you think? It's beautiful, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Compared to the Yuque's scenery... I suppose it's more natural.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Would it kill you to pay a compliment?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Yes.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Here we are.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Already? Wait, why are we at the station?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Because naturally we're taking the Express to get where we're going.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: All that buildup, and this is your idea of an "impressive method of travel"!?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Well, what else? That's why I said "you've definitely never seen this before." It's the Bullet Wyrm Express! I bet you've never taken a ride on this!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: You're the arbitrator of the Phantasmoon Games, for crying out loud. Don't you have a cooler way of getting around?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: You're a great General of the Xianzhou, for crying out loud. Don't you have a cooler way to get around?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Fine, fine. For the first time in my life, I finally know what it feels like to be the fool.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: The train bound for Seafeld City is arriving at the station.
rows.speaker: Stationmaster Meowton

rows.text: Hey, you got any money on you? Spot me a ticket, would ya?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: That's the second time.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: The sun is shining, and the vibes are immaculate! This is Fulwish TV's Happiness on the Street, bringing you real smiles straight from the streets of Seafeld!
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: You two look like visitors from afar. I take it you're also following Planarcadia's grand event, the Phantasmoon Games?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: Of course we're following it. It's not every day you see something this lively.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: That's great. We've noted many echoing widespread concerns that the Astral Express's intervention is dragging our sacred Phantasmoon Games into a quagmire of competition with outsiders. What are your thoughts on this?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: Widespread concerns? Mr. Reporter, I suspect your question already comes neatly packaged with its own answer.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Judging motives is futile. What we want to be focusing on is the real life consequences of our actions.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: That's so deep!
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: Many Seafelders feel that rather than any IPC vision of prosperity, it's the "Healing Smiles; Healing Arcadias" proposed by Lady Fulwish that is the more grounded future we desperately need! What is your take on this?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: If the Happiness comes at the cost of stripping away the perception of all pain, then it calls into scrutiny just how authentic such a happiness really is.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Exactly. By that logic, eating candy until your teeth fall out counts as happiness too, right? I mean, hey, at least it tasted sweet.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: That's a very... vivid analogy. Finally, a hypothetical question: If you had to choose, do you believe the Preservation defined by outsiders or the Happiness advocated by Ms. Fulwish better represents the future of Planarcadia?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: The real future has never existed within such a narrow dichotomy. Now, if you'll excuse me.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Thank you both for sharing! Have a wonderful day!
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: ...All defensive answers. Not a single morsel for us. This whole segment is wasted. Go find some citizens who can chuck us a few Happiness testimonials to pad out the reel.
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: Welcome! Come try our Happiness Soda! One sip, and you'll be as lucky as Director Fulwish all day long!
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: Why is it always Fulwish...? Doesn't she work in media? What's that got to do with soda?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Oh, you're an outsider, you wouldn't know! Director Fulwish is Seafeld City's pride and joy! She grew up just a street over. She's a true "Daughter of Seafeld"!
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: Can you imagine? After that terrible disaster fifteen years ago... *sigh* That child lost her whole family. Just a little kid... Truly heartbreaking...
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: But she did herself proud. She pulled herself through it all, relying on sheer grit and optimism!
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: Fulwish TV — ah, back then it was still called Seafeld TV — even produced a special documentary about her called A Smile Against Adversity. I can't even tell you how many people were touched by it!
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: And now despite all her success, she hasn't forgotten to bring happiness to everyone. It's just amazing!
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: Do you... really feel happy right now?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Of course! Just look at how happy I am! It's all thanks to the Research Society of Happy Smiles and Miss Fulwish! She not only supports the local economy, but she's brought with her a positive attitude toward life.
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: We can all be just like her, forget about all those painful memories from the past, and just be happy every single day!
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: Well, If you ask me, only someone who's come from suffering like her can truly want what's best for all of us! She's the one who can deal with those outsider Supplicants running amok, and bring glory to our people!
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: Come on, why don't you try some! It's on the house! You simply have to experience the unique taste of "Happiness" that we have here in Seafeld! Guaranteed to make you forget all your troubles!
rows.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper

rows.text: Bid farewell to painful memories and embrace the eternal now! Let the smile of happiness become your only truth!
rows.speaker: Smiles Society Publicist

rows.text: Follow Master Fulwish's path, embrace rebirth, and you and I can both become the happiest people in this arcadia!
rows.speaker: Smiles Society Publicist

rows.text: ...How very strange.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: No matter how many times I perform the divination, the signs hovering above the passersby in Seafeld City are all Weals, signifying peace.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: ...Is my "Eye of Īśvara" suffering interference from a Supplicant's abilities here? But... how is that possible?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I actually think your judgment is looking more and more likely. The pedestrians on the roadside, the fishermen at the port, the shopkeepers on the street, and... the ones preaching "Happiness"...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: From the moment I entered this port city, I felt it, something stirring gently within them, resonating with the same essence I carry.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: This entity is far too faint, I can scarcely feel its strength. It was once shattered to nothing, crushed into powder, burned down to ash... nearly extinguished.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: But it has no concept of death, and so it simply went to sleep. It quietly lurks, waiting for the farmer to scatter it across the fields. Given time, it will inevitably wake up again.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I believe most people in this city must have undergone the Happiness Surgery, just look at the spectacle the Smiles Society is putting on over there.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: At the Courtyard, you once said, "Fortune rests upon misfortune"...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: A great calamity for some, but for others, perhaps a turning point leading to ultimate bliss.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: If there really is something that lets people survive apocalyptic disaster... then a Weal slip hanging above their heads would be only fitting.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: ...However, those who survive will no longer be human.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: By that time, there won't be any need for a General of the Xianzhou to petition an audience... The gaze of The Hunt will be firmly locked on this place!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Follow me.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: What's your plan?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: My plan? As the referee of the Phantasmoon Games... uh, former referee I mean! When faced with a Supplicant who blatantly breaks the rules and dispenses "blessings" on a whim...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: The only thing I can do is... issue an "Executive Ruling."
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Is this it? You keep the sacred instrument out here in broad daylight? Aren't you worried someone might make it disappear?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Hold your horses. We've still got a ways to go. As for my precious measuring instrument, do you really think I'd just leave it lying around in the middle of nowhere?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: With all due respect, there is no path ahead.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I get it. It's probably just an optical illusion. Extraordinary beings like you always love pulling that "the path only opens to the destined" trick. What's next? A secret passphrase? Do I find a stone matrix and jump through it? Or maybe...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Do you sing a little song, wave your hand, and the trees just obediently stand up and split into two neat rows?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I'm no Woof Woof Dan... I don't have that kind of skill.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: A long time ago, I raised a floating island right here for someone to paint.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: To prevent others from wandering in by mistake, I asked that artist to paint thick fog and woodland here, so passersby wouldn't stray inside.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: We made a deal: As long as I play my {RUBY_B#Bizarre Melody}song{RUBY_E#}, the fog will disperse.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Not long before, in the Phantasmoon Courtyard...
You just said: "As for the brewing storm... Whether the turmoil once again is the result of The Laughter's mischief" ...What exactly was that supposed to mean?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: You mean to say the {RUBY_B#Aha}Joyseeker{RUBY_E#} wants to destroy the very rules THEY laid down, the game THEY wove with THEIR own hand?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Come over here.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: This fox mask is a ritual instrument I once used in dance and music. It accompanied me across vast distances in search of an elixir of immortality, a mark of who I was in life.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I've lost count of how long it has been since I last wore it since being enlightened and transplanted here. But here it is, presented upon the altar again. Which means...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: As the game's referee, you've been pushed onto the field. In this moment, you are now a Supplicant.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: For over a century, I presided over a war game in which Supplicants carved out their own territories and vied for supremacy using the power of the Masks.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I've also hosted survival games where Emanators took the stage to compete, invoking Aeonic powers to try and slaughter every last opponent in a single day.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Whenever the Phantasmoon Games are at risk of being suspended or disrupted, I will use the authority granted by the Elation and the Abundance to measure, judge, and punish any violators.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I guess you could call me the "security protocol" for the Phantasmoon Games. But now, someone has gone and designated me as a "Supplicant"... It's utterly unheard of.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Who else but The Laughter could pull off something like this?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Perhaps...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: ...Some entity harboring a deep-seated hatred for The Laughter?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Who could it be? Ugh, entities like that... I couldn't count them all even if I used my toes.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I warned that jerk ages ago: take a joke too far, and you're bound to make enemies. See? Instant karma!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Never mind who he is or what he's after. We're here now, so what do you plan on doing?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: "Fortune rests upon misfortune, and misfortune gives rise to fortune." Becoming a Supplicant isn't necessarily a bad thing. Wouldn't that allow you to step openly into this chaos and drag the puppet master into the light?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: You're looking to team up, with me? Team up with someone from the "Abominations of Abundance" that you Xianzhou people despise?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: That's hardly appropriate. You're an ancient, sacred tree. It's the furthest thing from an Abomination of Abundance, no?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Oh? Your standards are certainly flexible. The Hunt and the Abundance... We really make quite the interesting pair.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: So, where do you plan on starting?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: How about we start by freeing my friend in the tree?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Ah, I nearly forgot about that. Chirp away, little bird. I'll allow it.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: General Yao Guang, and... Miss Fox. I've received some news that might interest you.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: A Happiness Surgery that wipes away suffering? The power of Abundance in this world is disgustingly excessive.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: It seems the most terrifying omen I foresaw may not originate from the Stellaron Hunters, nor from Planarcadia itself. This Supplicant called Fulwish is also a dangerous variable.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: If you can, I would ask that you direct your focus toward... Seafeld City.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You want to take a trip to Seafeld City? ...It seems I'll have to use some special measures to shorten the journey.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Oh? This is the part I've been looking forward to the most. I've always been curious, where exactly this secret court is located, and what it connects to—
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Xianzhou lady, let me show you this world's most impressive method of travel.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: You haven't said a word the whole way, Xianzhou diviner. Are you mesmerized by the scenery... or is there something in your divinations weighing on your mind?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: After casting divinations a thousand times, one may learn to keep a still heart, yet each foreseen omen of doom still clouds the inner lake with gathering shadows.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: That is why before divining, I usually wipe clean my mind's eye to clear away stray thoughts, lest the outcome be disturbed.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Take a word of advice from someone slightly your senior, maybe it's nothing new to you: if we treat every approaching calamity like a final reckoning, wouldn't an infinite lifespan turn into prolonged suffering?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Enjoy the present... Indeed. Yet, worldly joys are fleeting as morning dew, while our duties are as immovable as heavy mountains.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Diviners often miss the fun right in front of them because they foresee tomorrow's suffering. But have you ever thought about this? That so-called suffering of tomorrow... might just be the poisonous fruit sown by you being terrified today?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: It is precisely because we know the ending that every scene along the way is so precious and unique, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Look at this harbor before us. When I first set foot here, all these streets, the fishing boats, the people... none of them existed.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: As far as the eye could see... there was only fire.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: The seas had been vaporized, leaving only fractured seabeds and ash that blotted out the sun. The demonic legions from beyond still hadn't departed, and the waves that would surge into Dovebrook had, in that moment, not yet arrived.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Just on the mountain over there, a painter and I looked out at the iron-red scars on the earth. She told me, "That which vanishes is bound to return." She swore to use her brush to preserve everything claimed by the Destruction.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: It seems she succeeded.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: And so, I too shall keep my promise to her, maintaining the course of the Phantasmoon Games until the sands of time slip away.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: With every descent into this game's cycles, I shall enjoy myself to the fullest. Like sipping tea, be it sweet or bitter, I shall savor the flavor of every instant. To do otherwise would be a disservice to the people and things that have passed.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: To savor a fleeting moment against the backdrop of eternity... naturally, the flavor is profound. A pity, though. Even as a long-life species, my time is brief compared to yours. As a Xianzhou native, the karma I carry is far too heavy. I could never learn how to be as... carefree as you.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Miss Evanescia, what to you is a game to be savored... is a life-and-death reality for the living beings of Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Alright then. Next up, I'm entering "brooding and edgy" serious mode.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: That... won't be necessary.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I shall use the "Eye of Īśvara" to divine the fates of the people in Seafeld City. If they face imminent catastrophe, a red Fate Slip will be hanging above their heads.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: The Reignbow surveys the heavens, perceiving a thousand forms. Across the meridians of destiny, the jade abacus reveals its script. The celestial eye opens and shuts, as calamity and fortune reveal themselves—
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Calamity looms overhead... The crimson slip is cast!
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Mr. Sunday will share my "insight" with you through the spirit bird, Miss Evanescia. Please bear witness.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: What are you laughing at?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: My apologies, I didn't mean to mock. I was merely curious... Is this thing really the "sacred instrument" with which you pass judgment upon Supplicants? Is it really just... a literal ruler?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Hey, don't underestimate this "Spiritbranch of True Law"! When it first appeared in the form of a blade 150 years ago it could cleave a mountain in half with a single effortless swing!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Miss Evanescia, let's keep such fanciful tales between us, shall we...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Best not go spreading them around. If any of the Cosmicon Collective players find out, we'll never hear the end of their complaints about how "mountain-busting power levels are for noobs."
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I never expected a high-ranking Xianzhou General to be so well-versed in the gossip here on Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Such is the way of a diviner. To enter a place is to observe its local custom.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Same goes for us arbiters. Times change, and my babies have to change with 'em.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Just picture it: a pretty girl in a school uniform, strutting through the streets with a giant sword slung over her shoulder? Yeah, right.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I see you are a law-abiding citizen, Miss Evanescia. Cute.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Now then, please begin your "measuring."
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Weigh and sever this world, and engrave the laws of the cosmos — Spiritbranch of True Law!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: By the scale that adjudicates reality and illusion, truth and falsehood... measure for me all sins beneath the Phantasmoon that transgress the law!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: What... is going on?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: It's telling me... Fulwish is not a Supplicant!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: If she's not a Supplicant, then there's no way to judge whether she's transgressed or not.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: ...What do you mean?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: If Fulwish isn't a Supplicant, why would she openly declare that she's joining the Phantasmoon Games? And that mask back at the altar shaped like an Octomorph... Just who does it belong to?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Behind that mask... countless Supplicants are wearing it. They're spread across all Seaf— No, all of Duomension City too...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Supplicants... They're everywhere!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Not in the history of the Phantasmoon Games... have I ever seen a situation like this!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: General, someone is approaching your position. It's Dan Heng, and...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Dan Heng, you've returned. And the one beside you...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Blade... Or perhaps I should call you by your true name, one of the Xianzhou's most wanted criminals: Yingxing.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: You've delivered yourself into my hands. Good.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: General of the Yuque... your vision remains confined within the laws of the Xianzhou.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I came here to kill our common enemy.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Our common enemy? You are the Xianzhou's enemy. Ever since you became a Stellaron Hunter, you have slain countless emissaries of judgment sent by the Xuling's Palace of Law to capture you. You even incited the artisans of the Zhuming to reforge your blade, entangling them in your crimes...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: But your most unforgivable crime... is daring to break into the Ten-Lords Commission restricted area on the Xianzhou Yuque with your accomplices. You destroyed the Ashen Stelewood, disturbed the slumber of our valiant heroes, and stole the secrets of the dead.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: What kind of "vision" drove you to commit the countless crimes of your past? And what common enemy could possibly stand between you and me? By all means, enlighten me.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Oh? While I was in seclusion all these years, you've clearly been up to quite a lot.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: If I'd known you were such a magnet for trouble back when you came to the Zhuming begging for a sword, I would've dragged you out of the forge and drafted you into my crew myself, tied up if necessary...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: And this would be...?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: A pleasure to meet you, General Yao Guang. It's truly touching that my friends on the Xianzhou have kept me in their thoughts for all these years.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I never change my name, no matter where I roam. I am La Mancha.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You're obviously using a fake name.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: The head of the Galaxy Rangers... I didn't expect this trip to come with such a pleasant surprise.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: General, I'm afraid old grudges will have to wait—
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What we need to discuss concerns the survival of this world, and that catastrophic calamity you foresaw in your divination.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I won't deny the crimes you've listed.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: But I know full well that the Xianzhou cares nothing for the life or death of someone guilty like me. What you truly want...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...is to exact a blood debt from the nemesis who has repeatedly awakened demonic stars, summoned abominations, and could not be slain even after a hundred deaths...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: You wish to subdue the Emanator of the Abundance, Shuhu, once again... and even deny THEM rebirth for all eternity.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: And now, General, I have brought this opportunity before you.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: If you are dead set on condemning me to answer for my crimes, I will submit to your judgment and board the Navis Astrigera for the Xuling's inquisition.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: But as I said, I did not come here today to play the savior. I came to stop the past from repeating itself, and... to prevent our common enemy from having their way.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: General, if you do not want the fate of the Battle of the Fanghu from thirty years ago to fall at your feet then you must believe what I am about to say—
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: The "Happiness Surgery" promoted by the Smiles Society utilizes none other than Shuhu's cells, cells acquired from an unknown source.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: You mean... everyone who underwent the surgery...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: ...have all become Supplicants. Once the Wishpower converges, the will of the flesh will awaken and turn every host into nourishment.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: The one wearing the Octomorph Mask is not a single person. It is... an Emanator of the Abundance, dismembered and currently parasitizing the bodies of the masses here.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Who on earth... could have brought something so terrifying to Planarcadia?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Patient Name: Planarcadia
Diagnosis: Sadness, Tears, Fear, and Misery
What are you trying to find out? Someone's secret, or someone's embarrassing story?
I'm sorry, but all that's left here are the scraps of joy from the arcadia.
A strange note is tucked inside the filing cabinet. It reads:
"For a patient, the defining trait is illness. Without it, they wouldn't be a patient. For a Planarcadian, the defining trait is happiness."
At the same time, in the tavern...
...What innocence? We all saw it with our own eyes: You got your Supplicant's mask stolen and were strung up for a beating!
rows.speaker: Fool Fanning the Flames

rows.text: Yeah, you even went out of your way to set up a livestream for yourself! Afraid the whole universe would miss your "heroic bearing", huh? A livestreamed public punishment! Hahahaha!
rows.speaker: Bystanding Fool

rows.text: What do you mean, "stolen"!? Can a Supplicant's affairs really be considered "stealing"? That's called... tactical emotional engagement! A tactic AND an art! Don't you get it?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Yoo-hoo! If it isn't the Astral Express's famous li'l raccoon~ Did you miss my pranks?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Did you get the invitation for the Supplicant debate at Fulwish TV?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: My oh my, talk about bad timing~ My stream got banned, and the leader of the haters confiscated my Supplicant mask. As for the debate, I'm afraid the spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak...
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: But seeing as you called, you clearly still have a shred of conscience left in you. Are you planning to give me a chance to haggle?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Answer me this question first: Is Fulwish really a Masked Fool?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The Tavern doesn't exactly register every Fool's name and address...
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: But having watched her stream, I believe she is. As for why... call it a kindred intuition. And...
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Just listen to her slogan: "Healing Smiles; Healing Arcadias"... That level of crazy? She's a certified Fool.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Most Masked Fools make a huge racket when they approach you. That "Hey look, I'm about to stir up some trouble" vibe is impossible to hide.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: But Fulwish is clearly the exception. Her brand of crazy is calm and sophisticated.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Look at that haute couture getup she's wearing, it's worth ten times a normal person's salary. Who'd have guessed a career woman with state levels of wealth who is always preaching social welfare would be a Masked Fool? Simply the most exquisite disguise!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: I'd like to ask you to look into her background for me.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Now that's going too far! You actually want me to betray another Masked Fool...!?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Give me the intel on Fulwish, and I'll return the mask to you.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hahaha! Betrayal itself, that's the finest reward of all!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Deal! Leave it to me. I'll contact you as soon as I get the intel.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Fulwish... Is there really someone like that among the Masked Fools?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: How come I'd never heard of her?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Maybe we should ask Giovanni about her. He's got connections everywhere, after all.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Not long after, Sparxie arrived at Giovanni's location.
How did you... get in?
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Never mind, that's not important. Welcome.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Don't be afraid. Relax. You're that streamer who caused a scene at Graphia Academy, right?
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Whoa-ho! Even a media mogul like you recognizes me?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: The first battle between Supplicants made your name known to all. I can hear the desire in your heart, Miss Sparxie.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: You can hear... my desire?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: You charged in here seeking answers, didn't you? To mercilessly tear the mask off another Masked Fool, see what cards she's holding.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: You'll get your wish.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Just like you, I obtained my own Mask through a twist of fate.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: But unlike most of you, I don't even want to touch it. So, I'm not like you, with all your miraculous powers.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: I possess only one trivial little talent: I can hear the happiness you desire most, deep within your hearts.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Happiness? My days are filled with happiness. But what about you? Are you alright? I saw what you've been through... You have my sympathy.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Sympathy, yes. Dr. Zhongshan called it the "Happiness Syntax." She mistook it for some kind of... disease. But I say, no, this is the blessing of the Elation.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Precisely because my past was so agonizing... the divine allowed me to hear the happiness deep in everyone's hearts, as a form of consolation.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: I can smell the pulsating desire within your heart. Like sweet honey dripping from a comb, it travels along your nerves, dissolving into a syrupy, sticky sweetness.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Tsk-tsk! No surprise there! After all, I'm just a sweet girl whose sugar content is totally off the charts!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: But Miss Connoisseur, merely savoring the scent isn't enough. Are you planning to... taste it for yourself?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: As you wish. Let us start tasting from the first bite...
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: "Recognition." Deep within your heart, you desire everyone's gaze to be filled with adoration.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: The secret you use to seduce the audience is the very same thing you crave yourself, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: ...Correct.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Next... comes "Victory." The first Supplicant battle was merely a minor setback. Without a doubt, once the Mask is back in your hands, you will conquer the entire Phantasmoon Games with ease!
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Heh... Hahaha. That's it! That's exactly how it should be!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: The Laughter will appear in person to crown you... crown you for eternity. THEY will weep and beg you to become the brand-new Aeon of Elation.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: And the end of all this is eternal "Fulfillment."
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: It's so... quiet...
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: All that revelry is nothing but hollow noise... meant to fill the void before reaching this ultimate "Fulfillment."
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Come here, newborn god. Behold this world that belongs to you. It lies at your feet, submissive, humble, within your grasp. Jump down...
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Throw yourself at it, embrace it. This paradise will become one with you, leaving no distinction between you.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: ...Heh... Haha... Hahahaha! So, this is Happiness... Syntax!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Interesting! You're quite the illusionist, making this dream feel so real!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: To think you could resist this perfect desire... What a contradictory girl. You make me feel both pity and curiosity.
rows.speaker: Fulwish (?)

rows.text: Haha, perfect? You've got it wrong. No matter how beautiful your illusion is, it can't change its essence. Once happiness is within easy reach, it becomes as bland as a cup of plain water!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: In {RUBY_B#Masked Fools}our line of work{RUBY_E#}, who hasn't tasted the true zest of life only after long torture?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Fulfillment? Listen to me, you phony Fool who can't even face your own {RUBY_B#pain}mask{RUBY_E#}—
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: What we Masked Fools do best... is distill pain into the strongest wine, and spin despair into the maddest joke!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Thanks for the "sugar water." It tastes pretty bland!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Since you refuse the sweet happiness I've offered, I have no choice but to... insist you drink the bitter wine of punishment.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: How about this, Miss Connoisseur? Why don't you have a taste of my spirits?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Welcome to the livestream! Planarcadia: Happiness Syntax — Honkai Chapter, starts now!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Too bad. Zero viewers.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: What's going on... Ploo Chips are out of stock again?
rows.speaker: Employee Shopping

rows.text: What can you do? Those are Ploo Chips we're talking about! An arcadia bestseller for over a decade, one bite drops you into a whole new world of crunch.
rows.speaker: Odd Shopkeeper

rows.text: Exquisite... a taste sent from another dimension.
rows.speaker: Odd Shopkeeper

rows.text: ...Is this a film set or something?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: A camera that is set up. Its position looks a little strange, like there's no need for it to exist.
(Lean in for a closer look)
(Leave)
This is a disaster. We didn't pick up a single scoop worth mentioning from the first two Supplicants. How am I supposed to publish any of this?
rows.speaker: Troubled Reporter

rows.text: What's the rush? I'll head over in a bit, find an angle, snap a few shots... The headline is entirely up to you.
rows.speaker: Confident Photographer

rows.text: Frowning over such a trifle? You should hurry up and get that Happiness Surgery done when you get the chance.
rows.speaker: Confident Photographer

rows.text: That doesn't sound like a good idea.
The first two Supplicants?
He gives you a puzzled look, then decides not to push the conversation any further.
Hey, hey... Uh, maybe we should save this for when we're back upstairs? This really isn't the best place to talk.
rows.speaker: Troubled Reporter

rows.text: Lookie here... how is "The White-Striped Wolf" polling so high? Just 'cause he looks cool? What gives?
rows.speaker: Confused Employee

rows.text: ...Who? That detective? Where'd he get a title like that...
rows.speaker: Drowsy Employee

rows.text: Oh, that special program? It's wrapping up already... By the way, when was the deadline again?
rows.speaker: Idle Director

rows.text: Uh... yesterday.
rows.speaker: Kind Employee

rows.text: Hey, could you help me track down some old episodes of Please Be Happy from before Director Fulwish took over? I'm looking to pull a few clips for a documentary.
rows.speaker: Document-Searching Employee

rows.text: That's easy. There's an archive of all the past episodes. But... I'd strongly advise against editing it that way. It might backfire on you. The Director doesn't like people digging up that part of the past.
rows.speaker: Database Manager

rows.text: ...Fair enough. Let me think of a different approach.
rows.speaker: Resting Employee

rows.text: Working overtime every day is killing me... And all that nonsense between the Director and the Astral Express? It's us bottom-rung employees who get put through the wringer, day in and day out.
rows.speaker: Slacking Employee

rows.text: Shh, the Express Crew is right next to us.
rows.speaker: Resting Employee

rows.text: I didn't expect Planarcadia to have a spot as peaceful as this...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I guess there are pros and cons. Even after all these years, public transport around here is still a huge hassle.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The TV tower is still a fair distance away. We'll have to walk the rest of the way.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Mr. Ashveil and I have arrived at the TV tower, they're still setting up the debate venue here, and nothing looks out of the ordinary.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: She went to find a way to cure the patients.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's weird... She's caused such a huge mess, yet she's still inviting people to this debate? Isn't she afraid of getting exposed in front of everyone?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Fulwish is challenging all the Supplicants, so her odds of winning were never high to begin with, she must have prepared a defensive position. We need to stay on guard at every instant.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I will publicly decline the invitation and prioritize the Abundance anomaly. Logic: Planarcadia needs a "CEO" right now more than it needs a Supplicant.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You got it! I'll be sure to spam a few extra bullet comments for you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who are you calling a comedian!? This girl's got beauty and brawn too!
