rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Then let's head out. We'll be in touch.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It is a bit unusual. We should be on our guard.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I'm not a Supplicant so I can't go up on stage with you later... Will you be nervous facing the cameras alone?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Good. Confidence is key in a debate, after all.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Now that's unexpected, especially from someone who's weathered so many big moments.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Time truly flies, you're all grown up now. Perhaps it won't be long before you no longer need my guidance.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Don't worry. I'll always be standing right where you can see me.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Might as well, it's good advertising for the firm. Besides, someone's got to be willing to get their hands dirty.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Talk about low-key, guess I'm just blind.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You guys noticed it too, right? The entire first floor of the TV tower is one big set arranged by Fulwish: a livestream broadcast.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: This is a prime opportunity to bait us into exposing our weaknesses. She certainly wouldn't miss it.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: While we're still preparing, she's baiting us into revealing a weakness... A fair debate? Not a single word out of Fulwish's mouth is going to be true.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: It's no use. I already checked, there isn't a single blind spot.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Speaking of which, I didn't expect you two to take action together.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Correct, but I submitted a fake surgery application to get a peek at what's really going on.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: There are personal reasons, too. The loss of pain being considered happiness... that's always made me keep a close eye on the Smiles Society.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Unfortunately, the regular members know almost nothing. I couldn't find any clues related to the Abundance. But regarding the surgery... they did leave behind some clues.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: When it comes down to it, it's just like the Phantasmoon Games, people love surprises, so over-preparing is pointless. I've met plenty of big shots, but nobody has a knack for grabbing attention like you do. Use that to your advantage and play things by ear.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Don't put too much pressure on yourself. Those obsessed with winning... are usually the ones who lose.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: When I left Planarcadia, someone once said this to me:
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Meanwhile, an emergency meeting is taking place on the Express.
...And that's the situation. Blade's getting restless because of Shuhu's flesh. I need to stay here and keep him from losing complete control.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Stay safe. Don't worry about us.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Turns out the happiness promised by the Smiles Society... is actually the flesh and blood of an Emanator of the Abundance. Seems like Fulwish's conspiracy goes far beyond just resurrecting the Herald of Death.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Sunny, what's the situation on your end?
You know each other?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It's a long story, I'll have to explain later. With the help of tuning, I will conceal my identity as a Supplicant and cooperate fully with [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: And General Yao Guang?
If the public catches wind of this, panic is inevitable. She knows we wouldn't dare risk exposing her in such a situation.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Allow me to add: the IPC has confirmed the scale of the Smiles Society. More than two hundred thousand citizens have undergone the Happiness Surgery.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: To extrapolate: The advantage these supporters provide Fulwish is negligible. The probability of your victory is... 71%.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I didn't expect it to be that high...
What is the IPC planning?
If the situation spirals out of control, I will immediately terminate the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: But until then, the PR department will do its utmost to support you and defuse Fulwish's PR offensive.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: That should be enough. Thank you.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Danger lurks everywhere right now. I don't think it's wise for all of us to rush to Seafeld City. March and I will stay in Duomension City, just in case something goes wrong.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Oh, right! We gotta watch the Express. It'd be a disaster if someone tried to steal our home. Besides, debates aren't really my thing.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We'll take it from here.
But comedians are way more popular.
Listen... give it a rest. Can't I get a moment's peace before the debate starts?

rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Sounds familiar, doesn't it? There's another line: "Judgment follows close behind, as The Hunt draws its bow to deliver a gift—"
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: "...a Lux Arrow piercing through Ahatopia."
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Who exactly... are you? Do you think you can write the "script"?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I imagine Elio's futile efforts look just like yours, don't they?
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: I not only know it, I can hold the pen. The future you abandoned will, by my hand, make a return as a spicy comedy.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Ooh! I've got it! How about we use this for the opening line—
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: "Tonight, a Stellaron Hunter dies in the arcadia."
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Finality versus Elation... The moment when Paths collide is always fascinating.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: You will either die in a blaze of glory, or die comically. I don't care. Both are equally amusing.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: I really have to ask, where does this confidence of yours come from?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Planarcadia is crawling with Emanators... How are you going to take us on? With a single {RUBY_B#Fulwish}Masked Fool{RUBY_E#} and a bunch of Abundance minions?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Do you know the secret to longevity? It's "don't die." ...To be honest, my answer is pretty much the same.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: The Emanators you speak of are nothing more than a tenth of a {RUBY_B#Pearl}pebble{RUBY_E#}, a piece of {RUBY_B#Evanescia}wood{RUBY_E#}, and... hmm...
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Oh, and a {RUBY_B#Yao Guang}warlord{RUBY_E#}!
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Hehe, who can you count on? You've even ruled yourself out.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Fulwish is just a front. The real culprit behind all these strange incidents... is you.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Fulwish is a good student. Unlike me, she doesn't procrastinate. She's decisive, daring to take action, by directly carving a smile onto everyone's face.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: I'm willing to give her project my full support. For instance... by trapping a certain buzzkill hacker in a Dark Zone with no exit.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Or perhaps, for you, that would actually be a treat?
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: I'm only hearing one thing: There aren't many people who can ruin your plans... but I'm one of them.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Your scheme is like a tower of blocks. All it takes is one little nudge from someone like me, and the whole thing comes crashing down.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Pulling out the blocks and watching it all come crashing down... That's my kind of game aesthetic too. If you hadn't joined the Stellaron Hunters, perhaps we could have been partners.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: You? Based on what?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: On the grounds that you've already lost.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: One last joke: On a scorching summer day, a popsicle was walking down the streets of the arcadia... and melted. Take a guess: What were its last words?
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: It said, "Ah, I've lost my cool."
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: What a pity. Compared to that popsicle, you don't even qualify as a joke.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: I'll ask one more time...
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You? Based on what?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Allow me to explain. Aether Copying, out of this batch of Supplicants, this is easily the most run-of-the-mill Mask ability.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: It wins on being easy and effective, perfect for veteran players. I gotta say, the Aeon of Elation knows a thing or two about gaming.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You're way out of your league. You want to play with me? Getting played by me is more like it.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You're too prepared for this to be a spur-of-the-moment decision. Did you not trust Pearl from the very beginning?
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: What are you talking about? I don't trust anyone.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: There was a moment when I started to view "everything" that was happening with suspicion.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Was it that "23-second" discrepancy?
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Aren't you clever. Elio is nothing if not cautious when it comes to variables that can affect the "script."
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Just because he can't see this place clearly doesn't mean he can't see elsewhere.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: The script he gave Kafka has nothing to do with Planarcadia, but it was incredibly detailed... every minute, every event, clearly laid out.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: If there's even the slightest discrepancy, it means I've got someone on my tail, some mysterious figure capable of interfering with the "script."
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Counting today's little stunt, you can add another item to the list: mental instability.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: A brilliant callback. It proves precisely why you are helpless against my abilities.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Why not take a look at the present? Killing you once is no different than killing you a billion times.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Unfortunately for you, I have all the patience in the world, while you are out of time. This arcadia is on the brink of destruction, and you are powerless to stop it.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Unfortunately for you, Planarcadia is none of my business.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I have no patience, and I don't care about time. I'm here for a mission, and Elio's objective, from the very beginning, was to smoke you out.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Take a guess. Who's the hunter, and who's the prey? When I rip your head off and kick it into the Dark Zone, will your powers still work then?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Come to think of it, I have seen a "script"...
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: I have a friend who is a master at inspiring others. We work together flawlessly. And in one particular possibility...
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: You, too, will kneel before us, and offer up Aha's head with your own hands.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Then just you wait...
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You're dead meat. I'll say it again: I always keep my word.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Hey there, little guy... You've got a rather unique look.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Since you look like a mean ball of chaos, I'll just call you "Mr. Meanie." No objections, right?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Why so serious? Do I look like I'm no fun?
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: I just want to play a "game" with you, hacker.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Don't even think about it. I don't care if you're a fan or a lunatic, get lost.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I'm not a fan, nor am I a lunatic.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Or perhaps, it was because I was a fan that I became a lunatic. Without even realizing it, you've pointed out the very essence of the Paths. How philosophical of you.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: There is something seriously wrong with you.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I'll take that as a compliment. I've heard your story... and heard about those seventy-six accounts.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Why does everyone in the cosmos, no matter how important they are, just love bringing that up?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: No offense. I just thought that, much like yourself, it's a not-too-shabby...
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: Joke.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie"

rows.text: I get it. You're the one who sent me the message.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I always keep my word. You're dead meat.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: No need to rush! We've got loads of time!
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: As long as you're willing! Game time is... "infinite"!
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: And it doesn't matter if you're not willing! Nobody gets into my game, and nobody gets out!
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: Uh-oh, spoiler alert: The reward for clearing the game is... I'll tell you my entire plan!
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: But by the time you've finished playing, you'll be "finished" too! Hahaha!
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: You done? Get lost.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: ...So, is this kind of "game" fun?
This was your first mission. A pity you had to cheat.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: No.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You don't even know the first thing about games. What gives you the right to call me a cheater?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You handed over that "cartridge" willingly. Why did you steal it back?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: I just took it back to play with. Saying "steal"... that's so hurtful.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Besides, you guys just left it lying around in the vault.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Fine. You think we were careless? Next time, we won't be. I'll put it in a containment room at Pier Point. Go ahead and try "borrowing" it then.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Nice idea, but the execution's a no-go. You guys can't even get in there without me.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: By the way, I changed the passcode for this cell, too. "1337." I can leave whenever I want.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Is this the skill of a top-tier hacker?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: That cartridge was clearly "the ending you refused," yet you still used it. Care to tell me why?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: It's gonna be "game over" anyway, so I'll play however I want.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: The ending's the same, so the journey doesn't matter? Sounds more like you're just making excuses for yourself.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: It's not the same. You guys believe in destiny. I don't. That's why I don't mind spoilers.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Then, when you see how things end for {RUBY_B#Lv. 999}you{RUBY_E#}, are you afraid... or excited?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Bored.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Because feeling bored proves I haven't become her.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: That's why I joined you... the Stellaron Hunters. Those who play the game to change the ending...
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Why am I suddenly thinking about that...
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: This is still Pearluxe Tower.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: This Joy-whatever dude... is her employee?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Exactly. Clearing up the truth is also a way to save these innocent people. I'm looking forward to seeing what you can do.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You said you'd turn a blind eye. I didn't think you'd actually be monitoring me.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: The road ahead is fraught with peril. I'm just watching your back on behalf of the IPC.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: If the worst happens and you end up an enemy of the whole world... I'll be there to switch to the world's side in the nick of time.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Oh.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I didn't take you for the humorous type.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Let's go.
I need a moment to get ready.
Are you ready? A fierce battle is ahead of us.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Time waits for no one. Make it quick.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We'll have to deal with the ones in the tower ourselves.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: What a shame.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Ha, look who's waiting.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: It's a total mess. We'll have to force our way through.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You! How!?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: We're going up through the elevator shaft this time...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Silver Wolf was right. The Joy Ascendants have calmed down.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "We're through. [Trailblazer], don't let your guard down."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Fulwish looks... strange..."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "...Come. I'll be waiting for you in the control room."
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: What a mess.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Where'd everyone go?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Watch it, someone's behind that door.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Happy... Happy...
rows.speaker: Joy Ascendant

rows.text: I'm tired... I can't smile anymore...
rows.speaker: Joy Ascendant

rows.text: Have you come to seek happiness as well...?
rows.speaker: Joy Ascendant

rows.text: Don't rush. Just wait for THEM to wake up... and there won't be any more pain...
rows.speaker: Joy Ascendant

rows.text: No one... will be left out...
rows.speaker: Joy Ascendant

rows.text: Hahahaha! Director Fulwish, you were born to be an actor.
rows.speaker: Producer

rows.text: A victim of the Bloodstained Games, walking out of the shadows step by step to become a symbol of Happiness, and creating the greatest miracle in viewership history.
rows.speaker: Producer

rows.text: What are you talking about?
Soon, you will understand everything. She is like my daughter, my creation! My Goddess!
rows.speaker: Producer

rows.text: Ignore him, he's completely lost it.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: They can't die. Hope that puts you at ease.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Sorry, I'm the one to blame.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...You'd better pray THEY don't look this way.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: This is a matter of life and death, we don't have time here to be sentimental. Otherwise, there will only be more casualties.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Twisting the facts. That's the only move she's got. I've seen it all before.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Just a little turbulence. Action is the best response.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: They've got a way with words. Give me a chance, and I could also spin a hundred yarns without repeating myself.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Wishpower is gathering... I have to say, Fulwish's approach is proving quite effective.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Fulwish is stalling for time. At this rate, it'll never end.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Guess! Struggle harder!
rows.speaker: Giant Smiley Face

rows.text: Quite the contrary. I am the truest portrayal of this arcadia...
rows.speaker: Giant Smiley Face

rows.text: Let me announce the answer: Standing before you is the "{RUBY_B#malice}Wishpower{RUBY_E#} of the Rabble"!
rows.speaker: Giant Smiley Face

rows.text: Don't. It's a long story.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Nope. I can only keep them quiet for a while. Stop them from going crazy again.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I hacked the beacons, then initiated 200,000 threads of operation. It's a high-level play, but I've got plenty of experience.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You have your games to play... and I have mine.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Elio didn't want us to tell you, but we talked it over and decided to ignore him for now.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Not at all. I'm nowhere near done.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: That's right. You're just one step away from taking me down.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Relax, [Trailblazer]. I don't intend to use "Happiness Syntax" on you.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: That won't happen...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: No one cares about your excuses...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I hope you know I got all that on record?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Because I'm going to defeat you and put an end to all this.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Time waits for no one. Make it quick.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Go forth, and trailblaze your victory.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Something's off. Dan Heng?

rows.text: I heard someone was messing with my data. I had to come lay down the law.

rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: Listen to that. So we're full-blown villains now?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: As for the remaining Supplicants...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I can't reach them. We'll just have to take things one step at a time.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Just a few minutes ago, these people were talking and laughing... We overestimated our opponents' humanity...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Are they dead...?
...No. It's probably more like... wanting to die, but being unable to.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Should I say, "classic you"? You have a great attitude.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "I used to be a fan of the Nameless too. I'd excitedly tell everyone: They're true heroes!"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "But look how that turned out. They don't care at all about whether the arcadia lives or dies."
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "What do we get for our sincerity? The Astral Express just smugly declares: Another trail to blaze!"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "[Trailblazer], I ask you: What gives you the right to call yourself a Trailblazer!?"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: [Trailblazer], are you okay?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Let's quiet down the onlookers first. With the IPC helping out with crowd control, hopefully it won't be too much of a hassle.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Isn't this completely out of control!? What is Pearl doing?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ... We're past the point of no return. The longer this drags on, the worse our odds get.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: But public opinion is a double-edged sword... and we can use it to our advantage.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: If we can just tear off Fulwish's mask, the tables will turn in an instant. The others must be taking action, too.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "Nothing new under the sun. Planarcadia wasn't the first victim."
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "A concerned citizen tipped me off: In fact, Jarilo-VI became an IPC asset practically the moment it waved goodbye to the Express!"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "What a pity, [Trailblazer]. This debate is no longer your show, but a trial for all citizens!"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "Friends in the audience: Whatever you do, don't look away!"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: Is this the debate Fulwish prepared?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I figured it was a trap, but these tactics are just despicable... It's truly shameful.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Don't get mad. Action is the best counterattack.
The elevator's cut.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: And the emergency exit's a no-go, too...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: We're short on time. Let's just scale the outside of the tower.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "The infamous Penacony. Needless to say, this one is the biggest culprit of all..."
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "He—"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: Hmm?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I cut the signal. She kept repeating herself, so I figured I'd make her shush.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Thank you.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ... Though, isn't it a little too quiet?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Careful, there's something on this floor.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: And it's a big one, too. My arm's starting to twitch.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Weird. You didn't have an episode?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Quite the contrary. When the first wave of the disaster burst out, he nearly lost his sanity.

rows.text: We fought a vicious battle, and paid... a cost. It was only when General Yao Guang showed him Yingxing's hand-forged token that he finally came back to his senses.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: According to the Stellaron Hunters' plan, Blade must be here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let me guess, something to do with stopping Fulwish?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Correct. Fulwish sought to exploit the Abundance, but she never expected another host of Shuhu to participate in the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What she can do, he can do too, in a different form. We just need to create an opening for Blade to seize the mask...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Then those two hundred thousand people can be saved.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Don't rule out the other possibility: Everyone dies at your hands.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ...If this were the IPC, they'd throw you in jail for sure.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: But for now, everything depends on you. The common folks are innocent.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "They're still advancing, trying to bury the truth with violence! But the Astral Express won't succeed! Elation shall not be defiled!"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "Thank you... everyone in the Smiles Society!"

rows.text: Why is there a live audience? Has Fulwish completely lost it?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: They're not like normal people. The vast majority have mutated.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: So Fulwish really can manipulate them. But right in front of the cameras? She ought to be avoiding suspicion.

rows.text: "Even though the IPC reduced them to this state, their inner desire still brought them back to the side of righteousness!"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: Ha... Haha...

rows.text: Healed already? That fast?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Haha... How can a person full of happiness ever die?
rows.speaker: Smiling Flesh

rows.text: What a pain. Drag this out any longer, and we really won't be able to kill them...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Prepare to break through. Let's go!
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ... There's no other choice. I'll stay behind and hold them off.

rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: It's better than us all getting stuck here together. Besides, if you guys aren't around, I'll finally get a chance to show off a little.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Go on. I won't die.

rows.text: You certainly have impeccable timing. Don't tell me you're already at Pier Point?

rows.text: I gave a hacker an assignment to track down the mastermind, but it seems she's gotten herself stuck.

rows.text: The signal from the TV station is causing interference with our comms. We can't keep this line open for long.

rows.text: And it won't take long for them to revive, either.

rows.text: ...Shoot. So just taking out Fulwish won't be enough.

rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: "Hello! Please support the IPC! All for the Amber Lord!"
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: What's this?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: That hacker's data slice. It will help you eliminate potential threats.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Spatially speaking, you're in the optimal spot to initiate the hack. Load it onto the nearby terminal, quick.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Just looking at this screen ticks me off. I wanted to smash it anyway, so this kills two birds with one stone.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Okay, looks like it worked. But why is it just the screen...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Pearl?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Can't get through again. Whatever...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Haha, how could that ever work? Peasant!
Peasant?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I'm talking about you! Hahaha!
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: Yeah, hahahahaha.
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: Looks like this is the "unknown force" Madam Pearl mentioned.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: They... are imagenated creations born from the synesthesia beacons... the Supplicant Masks of those two hundred thousand victims.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: No wonder the Joy Ascendants got tougher the more we fought. It wasn't their flesh and blood getting stronger. It was these weirdos pulling the strings.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: If we don't get rid of these smiley faces, there's no way we can stop Fulwish.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Why start analyzing now? Don't bother. Just empty your mind. Isn't that happiness?
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: Let's focus on what's right in front of us. If we can see it, we can deal with it.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Congratulations! You're the first lucky soul... to be voted off!
rows.speaker: Giant Smiley Face

rows.text: What the heck are you?
You're nothing but Fulwish's lie.
I am the mask everyone wears for themselves, Planarcadia's Meanie Phantasmoon!
rows.speaker: "Meanie Phantasmoon"

rows.text: My heart is filled with sorrow, yet my face is one of infinite joy. For the arcadia is dying, but the people have finally found their wishes.
rows.speaker: "Meanie Phantasmoon"

rows.text: And I am the executor. Those who do not smile shall be tried!
rows.speaker: "Meanie Phantasmoon"

rows.text: That should put a stop to the endless flame wars.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: What did you do?
You go handle Fulwish.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Oh, one more thing.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: This time, no one can see the path ahead. You're going to have to walk it alone.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Go. I wish you good luck.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You've got quite the patience, eavesdropping for this long.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: A real "mean" one.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Let's see just how long you can hide!
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Is this for the sake of ceremony again?
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie?"

rows.text: You finally showed up, mastermind.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: One more round! How about it?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Such a pity. If {M#he'd}{F#she'd} stuck around a little longer, {M#he}{F#she} would have witnessed an even more interesting truth.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie?"

rows.text: Is this appearance a future you've borrowed? In a certain possibility, you stand at the {RUBY_B#LV.999}pinnacle of the Emanators of Elation{RUBY_E#}, the universe's one and only true player!
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie?"

rows.text: Every game already cleared. No more challenges, no more thrills... and naturally, no more laughter. Just... silence. Haha, how many times have you worn that bored expression now?
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie?"

rows.text: For you, this is the last time.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I can tell. Right now, I'd be wise to stay out of the line of fire.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie?"

rows.text: Scared? Too late.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: How many more aces do you have up your sleeve? Play them one by one. I'm watching.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You'll see. Just not right now.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie?"

rows.text: Don't misunderstand, hacker. I'm only stepping behind the curtain because tonight's "comedy" stars someone else.
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie?"

rows.text: The Phantasmoon Games will continue, marching towards Destruction just as Amphoreus did...
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie?"

rows.text: Take a guess... This time, who will be mourning when the clock finally runs out?
rows.speaker: "Mr. Meanie?"

rows.text: ...The noise is gone.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Silver Wolf said just now... that this time, no one can see the path ahead...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So even the "script" stops working sometimes?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Looks like the winds of public opinion are starting to shift.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "The IPC is interfering with the live broadcast, but Fulwish TV will never yield!"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: "We will fight those despicable Supplicants from beyond the sky to the bitter end!"
rows.speaker: Broadcast

rows.text: As agreed, we'll meet up at the top of the tower.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Let's go. We shouldn't keep everyone waiting.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Cowardly vermin.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: We need to catch her. Immediately.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...I've gotta hand it to you guys. It takes real patience to sit through all her jibber-jabber.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Go on. I'll open a shortcut for you.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I'd like to see what other tricks she has up her sleeve.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Looks like we aren't the only ones making a move.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Let's make this quick. In the tradition of the Phantasmoon Games, it's Supplicant versus Supplicant...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Audience against audience.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Then I'll be counting on The Navigator to watch my back.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Please be careful.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: [Trailblazer], how should I put it... This feels like destiny.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, I defeated the Herald of Death with my own two hands. Fifteen years later, you have donned the Supplicant's mask.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I trust that if I could pull it off, there's no reason you can't do the same.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Stand back, everyone... Watch out for friendly fire...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Hmm?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Hey, where's [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: So you noticed it too... We're disappearing, one by one.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What are you guys talking about?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's you...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Hehe, do you like it? We turn a blind eye to one another. In our hearts, there is only "me."
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: Self-absorbed... Haha, blind to everyone else...
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: It doesn't matter if you can see or not. [Trailblazer], let's meet at the top of the tower!
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Going to the top of the tower? Haha, you're too late.
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: You'll be picked off, one by one.
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: Your companions are right beside you, yet you will die alone.
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: Truly unfortunate, and truly funny!
rows.speaker: "Meanie Kiddie"

rows.text: They disappeared... What's going on?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Disappeared? No, no, no...
They're merging into one, never to be parted again.
rows.speaker: Giant Smiley Face

rows.text: Would you rather die than laugh?
rows.speaker: "Meanie Phantasmoon"

rows.text: Wait, who are you?
rows.speaker: "Meanie Phantasmoon"

rows.text: Talk is cheap. If you've got the guts, put ME on trial.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: This "Meanie" family of yours sure has quite the colorful cast of characters.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I'll do you a favor while I'm at it.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Little hacker, once I've formatted every byte of your data you won't even be able to record a whimper...
rows.speaker: "Meanie Phantasmoon"

rows.text: Don't rush. I'll send you to meet "Mr. Meanie" right now.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Take a guess. At which stage does a boss like you usually appear?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Just one place, the tutorial.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: There's still hope!
Life is short, why not smile more? We are all recipients of Aha's blessings.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: You want to demand an apology from the world of fifteen years ago? That doesn't give you the right to hurt innocent people.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You want to demand an apology from the world of fifteen years ago? You're the one who's become the aggressor.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Gods are fools, mistaking malice for mirth. Mortals are shams, masking malice with mirth.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Don't engage her! The camera is on us...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: No. I have come to pass judgment.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: It doesn't matter. A journey is supposed to change a person.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Since we're already here, we might as well give it our all.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Those who gaze upon my back will find the answer on their own.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: As long as I don't forget, there will always be someone to remember the meaning of a "smile."
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Because the decision isn't mine to make... It belongs to the people watching me.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Why three minutes?
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: Please, give us your Wishpower!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That giant flower...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...is the true owner of the mask.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Haha... Hahaha...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Seeing how ghastly everyone looks, let me tell one last joke.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: On that bloody evening fifteen years ago, a student covered her mouth and hid in a broom closet, watching as her friend was smeared across the blackboard like paint.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: After she was rescued, she couldn't go home. The adults brought her two small boxes. Her parents were inside.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: From then on, she lived inside a wardrobe, until a granny from the mutual aid society knocked on her door...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: "Child, you have to come out. There are so many others like you..."
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: "We can help each other pick up the pieces, bit by bit."
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Did that child find a way out? Yes, and thank goodness.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Every day, she received letters of encouragement filled with smiley faces. She returned to school, spending her days and nights with new friends.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: People held her hand and said, "Go get 'em! You're the pride of the arcadia."
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: And I said, "That's right. I am the pride of the arcadia."
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Click! That's the one! The perfect "tearful smile"!
rows.speaker: Producer

rows.text: Where are the cameras? What are you doing hiding in the back? Get in here! We need to capture every single detail!
rows.speaker: Producer

rows.text: I don't... quite understand.
rows.speaker: Teenage Girl

rows.text: I understand everyone wants to document happy moments for me, but...
rows.speaker: Teenage Girl

rows.text: Why are there so many cameras?
rows.speaker: Teenage Girl

rows.text: ...Mr. Collier, you're getting too excited. You let the cat out of the bag.
rows.speaker: Cameraperson

rows.text: ...No big deal. We can edit it in post.
rows.speaker: Producer

rows.text: Post? Edit? What are you talking about...
rows.speaker: Teenage Girl

rows.text: ...Fulwish, congratulations.
rows.speaker: Cameraperson

rows.text: Just moments ago, you conquered every last viewer! Ratings for the elating show Please Be Happy just hit an all-time high.
rows.speaker: Cameraperson

rows.text: The investors made the call immediately and green-lit the budget for the next three seasons! Cast members, and especially you, Fulwish, great work! You are the pride of the arcadia!
rows.speaker: Producer

rows.text: What... did you say?
rows.speaker: Teenage Girl

rows.text: So... the people who helped me... Uncle August, Miss Bai... were they all actors?
rows.speaker: Teenage Girl

rows.text: But I... my tears, they weren't fake at all...
rows.speaker: Teenage Girl

rows.text: "The Inspirational Girl Who Survived the Herald of Death Tragedy." A one hundred percent true story. That's exactly the effect we're after.
rows.speaker: Producer

rows.text: Remember to look at the camera, superstar. Give us another smile!
rows.speaker: Cameraperson

rows.text: That night, she locked herself in her room again.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: She turned away from every camera lens, hoping for just one person — anyone — to offer a sincere apology.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: But in the end, she received only a feather-light package. Guess what was inside?
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: A Fool's Mask.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Correct, but not quite. There was a note behind the mask, and it read...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: "The way you cried, you looked like a complete joke."
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: No. I'm trying to become the joke everyone expects me to be.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: How could that be? I merely turned people into actors in front of the lens... That is all.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: So, my dear Supplicants, go ahead...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: "I know! You just want to turn me into a mindless monster too, don't you!?"
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Did she... implant Shuhu's cells into her own body?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Viewers... I knew it! They're trying to frame me! Soon, I'll lose my mind.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: But I will never yield! For the first time in my life, I will {RUBY_B#utilize Happiness Syntax}speak words of Happiness to myself{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: O Laughter! I will spit... right in your smiling face!
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: I want to see... When a mortal destroys the {RUBY_B#Phantasmoon Games}elating show{RUBY_E#} you've been amusing yourself with...
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Will you still be able... to laugh?
rows.speaker: Fulwish

rows.text: Fulwish's transgressions have been judged by the Phantasmoon. Now, I will return everything to its proper course.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: It is simple.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: By my hand, the Joy Ascendants will {RUBY_B#merge together}return to the embrace of the Master of Immortality{RUBY_E#}. Even if Shuhu were to rise again, the outcome would be the same.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: The contest between Fulwish and myself is still undecided. It's not time for the referee to step in yet. Besides...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Dragging two hundred thousand innocent people to the grave... I can't accept that.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Innocent?
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: The "innocent people" you speak of are willingly offering up their Wishpower to the enemy, driving you into a corner.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: I can see it clearly. Their support for Fulwish, and their hostility toward you... it's all from the heart.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: So what if it's true? As long as there's still someone out there who has hope, I won't give up.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Indeed. In Aha's games, right and wrong are of no consequence.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: So you must understand: Everyone you save today could just as easily turn around and spit on someone else — or perhaps even you — tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: On the Path of Elation, humor and cruelty hold equal strength. Fulwish bested you because she granted all living beings the right to "mockery."
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: Mocking you, her, even themselves. Mocking everything disappointing about this arcadia. As you can see, people have chosen the "masks" she offered.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: To think a mere game could change the world... That is nothing but a fantasy.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: I only believe one thing: People are disappointed in the world because they want it to get better.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And I can show them... that someone will always step up.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You don't even have a decent mask.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: But... You seem to be hiding an interesting ace up your sleeve.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: If you allow that Wishpower to surge into you unchecked, you'll end up just like Fulwish... tainted by it, losing your sense of self.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: And how can you be certain that you won't be changed by the Elation?
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: It doesn't matter who I used to be.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What matters is what I want people to see when they look at me.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Not everything needs a reason...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I don't need to give an answer. I just need to keep moving forward.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Even if the world isn't kind to us, that's okay.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Even if it is meaningless, I must still do all that I can...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...There is no need to question your heart, no need to crave victory.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: All I know is that Fulwish's actions... fill me with rage!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Another Nameless.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: I have awakened only three times in a millennium. Two of those instances arose from the "exceptions" you brought.
rows.speaker: Evanescia (?)

rows.text: This is it.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Everyone just wants you to live out a good life.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I can tell. This Path really suits you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm not sure why, but after leaving Amphoreus, the blood of the Permanence that had long lain dormant within me began to pulse once more.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm going to speak with Blade, and General Yao Guang too. I'm curious about the "funeral" that was mentioned just now. Could... could this be... the release he's been waiting for all this time?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Saying thanks? You're making us sound like strangers.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I'm fine. Linking everyone's thoughts together... reminded me of Ena's Dream.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I think it's time I headed back to the Express for a rest. I've got a feeling I'm in for a lecture from Mr. Yang.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Thank you, Himeko, for taking us on this journey.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Just now. I saw you were discussing Blade, so I didn't want to interrupt.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Mm-hmm. One cup of coffee to pick you up and wipe away the fatigue. Look forward to it, okay?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Mm-hmm, it's a deal.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm going to see someone. I'll be back on the Express soon, wait for me.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Blade was taken away by that Xianzhou lady. Danger.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Alright? He's anything but! He's got so many issues!
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Keep playing the Phantasmoon Games, obviously. What was that line again...
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I told you not to ask. Just know there's a story behind it and leave it at that.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Being the center of attention is worth rejoicing over.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: For those poisoned by Fulwish? Or... for Fulwish herself?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Feeling lost and empty... That's really not like you, "Protagonist."
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: What about you? Am I speaking to "Evanescia"... or "her"?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: For those who have suffered misfortune... for the Daybreak Warriors, the Synwish Syndicate... and perhaps Skott as well.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: A victim of the Herald of Death... became a new "Herald of Death."
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: For this... not-so-joyful "arcadia."
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: For these games... Perhaps in a game like this, there is no victory to speak of.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...You have infinite life.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Yes, I have a favor to ask of you.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: A millennium ago, Graphia sacrificed herself to create a plane within the painting to resist the demon legions from beyond. Since then, she has been slumbering in the deepest reaches of the scroll.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: While you were fighting... I was using the power of Abundance to heal the wounds of all those affected.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Evanescia?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Don't crowd around me. I'm not dead yet.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: If you want to say your goodbyes or catch up on old times, form a line...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Nice work, Bladie.
The word "live" seems rather disrespectful to him.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Saving a planet from the scourge of the Abundance is indeed a monumental achievement.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: You missed the entire battle. Where did you go?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Apologies. I had a long talk with someone, and spent quite some time divining the future, peering into the possibility of the Reignbow's intervention. Fortunately...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Thank you, Stellaron Hunter. I say this with the utmost sincerity.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: So, did your hexagram reading come true?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "Dragons clash in the wilderness, their ichor dark and yellow"... I assumed the High Elder and his nemesis would engage in a bloody battle.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: But it appears the prophecy did not come to pass.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Perhaps those words hold a deeper meaning...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Before heading to the TV Tower...
"The battle is over... Have you... regained your sanity?"
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Ha... haha... Thank you."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "...But doing just this... isn't enough!"
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "What are you doing?"
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Why... Why are you plunging the fragments of the Shard Sword into your own body?"
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "I... hate. Shuhu is right before my eyes... Only this way..."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "...can I remain lucid... and remember those mistakes..."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "Only in this way... can I face the coming death-match!"
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: He uses a fragmented sword to maintain his sanity. The pain must be indescribable.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Ichor dark and yellow"... refers to the color of the Shard Sword when it shatters.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I see. That's a fascinating interpretation of the hexagram. But we've strayed from the topic at hand...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: As an envoy of the Xianzhou, it appears I must fulfill my mission now.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: ...Now?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Escort me back to the Xianzhou, to remain imprisoned for all eternity...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Or perhaps... execute me on the spot?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: If you want to make a move on a Stellaron Hunter, you'll have to answer to me.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I'm not unreasonable. I can grant you the ending you've been seeking: a dignified funeral, all your own.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: If everyone is in agreement, then come with me so we can discuss the plan. As for the burial site... I have chosen Planarcadia, at the end of the World in Canvas...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Sealed there is the entity that will allow you to exact revenge on Shuhu.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I'm flattered I managed to slip into your blind spot.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: With everyone's eyes fixed on Fulwish, Pearluxe Tower's security really isn't what it used to be...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: But that doesn't explain how a mere security officer could sneak in. Answer me this, Miss Kuchiba: Just what sort of secret are you hiding beneath that "mask" of yours?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: A Masked Fool? A spy from the Marketing Development Department? Or... the ninth Supplicant?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: As of right now, I'm still a security officer for the Department of Aberration Defense, and just as dutiful as you are. All I want is for the Phantasmoon Games to continue.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: And as for how much I'm willing to divulge during this conversation... that depends entirely on your sincerity.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: What do you want to know?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I know the IPC has been plotting in Planarcadia for years, and it certainly isn't for the authority of the Elation.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: What you're trying to lay your hands on is the darkest secret of this world... a horror sealed away by the Aeonic game...
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: The remains of the Aeon {RUBY_B#the Voracity}Oroboros{RUBY_E#} are on Ahatopia, right?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba
